General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, and householders' names.

General-content county map showing towns (townships), rural buildings, and householders' names. Relief shown by hachures. Hand colored to emphasize town boundaries and territories. LC copy imperfect: Fold-lined, mounted on cloth backing, laminated, sheets halved to enable folding. Includes inset of Kingston/Roundout, inset of Saugerties, illustrations of prominent buildings, and embellished border (hand-colored cornstalk leaves and ears).
